title: IDF Airstrike on Nuseirat Apartment Kills Three-Member Abu Mlouh Family Including 1-Year-Old Son
detail: An Israeli airstrike struck an apartment in the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza at dawn on May 24, 2026 (Day 956 of the Gaza war), killing three members of the Abu Mlouh family: a father, a mother, and their 1-year-old son. The family was among the civilians sheltering in the camp who had been displaced from other areas of Gaza. The strike on a residential building in Nuseirat continued the pattern of near-daily IDF operations across central Gaza since the security cabinet authorized war resumption on May 10. Separately, overnight strikes also struck a house in Deir al-Balah, causing extensive destruction. The cumulative death toll of Palestinians killed since October 7, 2023 stands at 73,800+ confirmed (Gaza Ministry of Health).

media.caption: IDF strikes Nuseirat apartment — Abu Mlouh family killed, including 1-year-old, May 24, 2026

title: IDF Strike on Central Gaza Police Station Kills 7 Including 5 Officers and a Child; Hamas Weapons Depot Also Destroyed
detail: An Israeli airstrike hit a police station in central Gaza around 07:00 local time on May 24, 2026 (Day 956), killing at least 7 people: 5 Hamas police officers, 1 child, and 1 additional civilian. Officers had been conducting market monitoring and civilian security duties at the time of the strike. Separately, the IDF reported destroying another Hamas weapons depot in central Gaza containing explosive devices, RPG launchers, hand grenades, and ammunition magazines — secondary explosions confirming the presence of weapons. Since the Israeli security cabinet authorized war resumption on May 10, the IDF has systematically targeted Hamas's reconstituted security and logistics infrastructure throughout Gaza, claiming Hamas had used the 212-day ceasefire to rearm and rebuild command structures.

media.caption: IDF strikes central Gaza police station and weapons depot — Day 956, May 24, 2026

title: UN Reports Only 906 Aid Truckloads Reached Gaza Since Rafah Operation; Flash Appeal Only 13% Funded
detail: As of May 24, 2026 (Day 956), the UN reported that only 906 aid truckloads had reached Gaza since Israel's Rafah operation began in mid-February — a catastrophic shortfall. The 2026 UN Humanitarian Flash Appeal requesting $4.1 billion remains only approximately 13% funded. Aid truck entries dropped from a 4,200 weekly average to 590 trucks after Israel closed all crossings in late February during military operations; volumes remain below pre-February levels. Only the Kerem Shalom (Karem Abu Salem) and Zikim crossings remain operational. OCHA reports 46% of essential medicines are out of stock in Gaza's 37 hospitals, none of which is fully functional. An estimated 1,400+ patients have died waiting for medical evacuation since May 2024. HRW's latest report documented that Israel has curbed aid access and continued to kill civilians during the nominal ceasefire period.
